description: WYSIWYG Markdown editor: edit Markdown files directly in the preview.
config.language.enum1: Follow the VS Code display language (Japanese if it is Japanese, otherwise English)
config.language.description: Language of the editor screen, messages, and help.
config.docStyle.enum2: Looks like the Markdown preview of Visual Studio Code
config.textColor.enum1: Almost black (a light color with a dark theme)
config.textColor.enum2: A slightly lighter gray (a slightly darker color with a dark theme)
config.docWidth.enum1: Centered, with a maximum width of 884px
config.docWidth.enum2: Use the full width of the editor
config.softBreak.label1: Do not break until a blank line
config.softBreak.label2: Break lines as in the source
config.softBreak.enum1: Same as CommonMark and the VS Code Markdown preview
config.softBreak.enum2: Show line breaks where the source has them
config.softBreak.description: How line breaks within a paragraph (line breaks without a blank line) are shown. The saved content is the same either way.
